entries.rationale: BEH-2/INV-6 fully specified with test code and an implementation sketch; issues-stale.mjs is a direct sibling shape; 4 cohesive files, read-only verb. Tier: quick.
BEH-3 plus the ready-filter algorithm and its dangling-dependency edge case are spelled out; sibling verb shape exists; read-only, 4 files. Tier: quick.

Board writes with guard refusals (BEH-4/5/6, INV-5). No existing verb translates BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCIES/cycle into exit 2, and update resolves epic-vs-issue by lookup; matches the spec's Medium-risk Migration Step 2. Tier: full.
Additive --epic/--milestone flags on a verb already under test; no new behavior of its own, so acceptance detail is thinner, but the change is mechanical across 3 files. Tier: quick.

BEH-7's always-present confirmFn is load-bearing (an omitted callback silently ships), plus four result-translation outcomes and gate timeouts. No sibling verb wraps lib/milestones.mjs; spec's Medium-risk Migration Step 4. Tier: full.
BEH-8 with an explicit case table; help-text and --help short-circuit only, but it touches six files across the new verb set. Tier: quick.

Single new test file, but the plan flags the unit-vs-integration strategy at medium confidence and leaves an open branch (fix resolve-root.mjs if BEH-1 really fails). Hermetic git worktree fixtures need a human check. Tier: full.
BEH-9/INV-3/INV-7 with the exact enforcement test and the exact prohibition prose; precedent wording exists in the plan/implement/reconcile skills; two files. Tier: quick.
Docs edit plus a scripted mirror regeneration pinned by the existing parity test; spans docs/ and providers/, and the final sweep is a judgment call, but the mechanism is mechanical. Tier: quick.
